missing_information_behavior: Do not provide a universal timing interval; identify medicines and verify product labeling or pharmacist guidance before use.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume psyllium is compatible with every oral medicine.
Do not apply one separation interval to all medications.
Retain swallowing and adequate-fluid safety checks.
professional_escalation_conditions: Medicines with narrow therapeutic index or timing-sensitive absorption.
Dysphagia, esophageal narrowing, suspected obstruction or complex polypharmacy.
population_and_context: People taking regular medicines who are considering psyllium; timing and absorption interactions depend on the specific medication and product label.
dose_constraints: Follow the specific product label and pharmacist/clinician advice on separation from medicines; no universal interval from this rule.
certainty_and_limitations: FDA psyllium safety information and product labeling should be checked for exact formulation. Drug-specific interaction timing requires authoritative product monographs or pharmacist review.
